whimper.englishDescription: For a child to cry with an ugly-looking, frowning face continuously.

whimper.englishDescription: To cry or throw tantrums repeatedly when dissatisfied or displeased.

whistle.definitionKo: 증기 기관으로 움직이는 배에서 신호로 내보내는 큰 소리.
whistle.englishDescription: A loud sound, as a signal sent out from a boat or ship powered by a steam engine.

whistle.definitionKo: 가느다란 철사나 줄 등에 세찬 바람이 부딪쳐 울리는 소리가 계속 나다.
whistle.englishDescription: For the sound of a strong wind blowing against a thin wire, string, etc., to be heard continuously.

whistle.definitionKo: 거센 바람이 전선이나 철사 등에 빠르고 세차게 계속 부딪치는 소리.
whistle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of a strong wind continuously blowing against electric lines, wires, etc., in a fast and furious manner.

whistle.definitionKo: 거센 바람이 전선이나 철사 등에 빠르고 세차게 부딪치는 소리가 계속 나다.
whistle.englishDescription: For the sound of a strong wind blowing against electric lines, wires, etc., fast and furiously to be heard continuously.

whistle.definitionKo: 거센 바람이 전선이나 철사 등에 빠르고 세차게 계속 부딪치는 소리가 나다.
whistle.englishDescription: For the sound of a strong wind blowing against electric lines, wires, etc., fast and furiously to be heard continuously.

whistle.definitionKo: 입술을 좁게 오므려 그 사이로 숨을 내쉬어 소리를 내다.
whistle.englishDescription: To put the lips close to each other and make a sound by exhaling between them.

whistle.definitionKo: 입에 물고 불어서 소리를 내어 신호하는 데에 쓰는 작은 도구.
whistle.englishDescription: A small implement one blows into while holding it between lips to produce a sound signal.

whistle.definitionKo: 입으로 불어서 소리를 내어 신호를 보내는 데에 쓰는 도구.
whistle.englishDescription: A small implement one blows into while holding it between lips to produce a sound signal.
A word imitating the sound of whistling.

whistle.definitionKo: 입술을 동그랗게 오므리고 그 사이로 입김을 불어서 내는 소리. 또는 그런 일.
whistle.englishDescription: A sound made by letting out breath through pursed lips; or such an act.

whistle.definitionKo: 조금 길고 힘 있게 휘파람을 부는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
whistle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of blowing a whistle a little longer, powerfully.

whistle.definitionKo: 조금 길고 힘 있게 휘파람을 계속 부는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
whistle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of blowing a whistle quite long and powerfully in a repeated manner.

whistle.definitionKo: 거센 바람이 전선이나 철사 등에 빠르고 세차게 부딪치는 소리가 계속 나다.
whistle.englishDescription: For the sound of a strong wind blowing against electric lines, wires, etc., fast and furiously to be heard continuously.

whistle.definitionKo: 휘파람을 짧고 힘 있게 부는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
whistle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of blowing a whistle powerfully, briefly.

whistle.definitionKo: 가느다란 철사나 줄 등에 세찬 바람이 부딪쳐 울리는 소리가 계속 나다.
whistle.englishDescription: The continuous sound of a strong wind blowing against a thin wire, string, etc., to be heard continuously.

whistle.englishDescription: The continous sound of a strong wind blowing against a thin wire, string, etc., to be heard continuously.

white book.definitionKo: 정부가 정치, 경제, 외교 등에 관한 현황이나 전망을 국민에게 알리기 위하여 만든 보고서.
white book.englishDescription: An official government report, which informs the people of the present situation or prospect of politics, economy, diplomacy, etc.

white sand beach.definitionKo: 강가나 바닷가에 흰 모래가 넓게 깔려 있는 곳.
white sand beach.englishDescription: A place where white sand is vastly spread by the riverside or seaside.

wholesale trade.definitionKo: 물건을 낱개로 팔지 않고 여러 개를 한꺼번에 파는 장사. 또는 그런 장수.
wholesale trade.englishDescription: Business that sells products in bulk, not by the piece, or such a seller.

wicker tray.definitionKo: 싸리나무나 대나무 등을 가늘게 쪼개 둥글넓적하게 엮어 만든 그릇.
wicker tray.englishDescription: A container made by splitting bush clover, bamboo, etc., thinly and weaving the strips into a round, flat tray.

wide awake.definitionKo: 눈빛이나 정신 등이 생기가 있고 맑다.
wide awake.englishDescription: One's eyes, spirit, etc., being lively and limpid.

willfully.definitionKo: 자기 생각이나 주장을 굽힐 줄 모르고 굳게 버티는 태도로.
willfully.englishDescription: With the attitude of being stubborn and insisting on an idea or opinion.

wiretapping device.definitionKo: 남이 하는 이야기, 전화 통화 내용 등을 몰래 엿듣기 위한 기계.
wiretapping device.englishDescription: A machine to eavesdrop on other people's conversation, telephone calls, etc.

with a smooth motion.definitionKo: 미닫이가 미끄러지듯 가볍게 열리거나 닫히는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a smooth motion.englishDescription: With a sound resembling one that is produced when a sliding door opens or closes smoothly and softly, or such an action.

with cracks.definitionKo: 단단한 물건이 자꾸 부러지거나 서로 부딪치는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with cracks.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the movement of a hard object breaking or hitting against another hard object again and again.

with cracks.definitionKo: 크고 단단한 물체가 자꾸 부러지거나 끊어지는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with cracks.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of big, hard objects being broken and cut repeatedly.

without complaint.definitionKo: 이런저런 불평을 하거나 덧붙이는 말이 없이.
without complaint.englishDescription: Without any complaint or additional comment.

womb.englishDescription: The part in the female body where a baby  is conceived.

womb.definitionKo: 아기가 태어나기 전까지 자리해서 자라는 여자의 몸속 기관.
womb.englishDescription: The organ within a female body, where a baby grows before its birth.

work in a common rank.definitionKo: 일정한 지위 없이 그 일에 뛰어들어 일하다.
work in a common rank.englishDescription: To jump into and perform a task without holding a certain title.

workaholic.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 일을 하지 않으면 불안함을 느끼는 상태.
workaholic.englishDescription: (figurative) A state of feeling anxious if one does not work.

wounded part.englishDescription: An area of the body that is affected by illness or where a wound forms.

wretchedness.definitionKo: 견딜 수 없을 정도로 슬프고 끔찍함.
wretchedness.englishDescription: An unbearably sad and dreadful feeling.
The state of being very miserable and feeling terrible.

yell in anger.definitionKo: 있는 힘을 다해 큰 소리를 지르며 기를 쓰다.
yell in anger.englishDescription: To exert oneself to the utmost shouting aloud.

yoreomyeon.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '요리하면' (a conjugated form of '요리하다' (do this way)).
An abbreviated word for '요러하면' (a conjugated form of '요러하다' (be this way)).

you can never defeat someone who knows m.englishDescription: It is hard to win against someone who has full knowledge and understanding of something.
